description: National mission for financial inclusion to ensure access to financial services like banking, savings, deposit accounts, remittance, credit, insurance, and pension in an affordable manner.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen aged 10 years and above. No minimum balance requirement.
benefits: Free RuPay debit card, accident insurance cover of ₹1 lakh, overdraft facility up to ₹10,000 after 6 months, zero balance account, direct benefit transfer of government schemes.
how_to_apply: Visit any bank branch with Aadhaar card and one photograph. Account can be opened with self-attested Aadhaar. Available at all public and private sector banks.

description: Provides loans up to ₹10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises for income-generating activities.
eligibility: Small business owners, shopkeepers, artisans, vendors, service providers, manufacturers. No collateral required.
benefits: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001-₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5-₹10 lakh) loan categories. Low interest rates (8-12%). No processing fee or collateral.
how_to_apply: Apply through participating banks, MFIs, NBFCs. Submit business plan, identity proof, address proof, business registration if applicable. Online application available on Mudra website.

description: Government-backed pension scheme for unorganized sector workers providing guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000-₹5,000 after age 60.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18-40 with savings bank account. Aadhaar mandatory.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension ₹1,000/2,000/3,000/4,000/5,000 based on contribution. Pension to spouse on subscriber's death. Nominee gets corpus if both die. Government co-contributes 50% for eligible subscribers (benefit ended in 2015-16).
how_to_apply: Open through bank with Aadhaar, mobile number, and nomination. Auto-debit from savings account. Contribution varies by entry age (₹42-₹1,454/month). Managed by Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA).

description: Pension scheme for senior citizens providing assured returns and regular monthly income.
eligibility: Indian residents aged 60 years and above.
benefits: Assured return of 7.4% per annum. Monthly/quarterly/half-yearly/annual pension options. Maximum investment ₹15 lakh for ₹10,000 monthly pension. Policy term 10 years. Premature exit allowed on medical emergency. Loan facility up to 75% after 3 years.
how_to_apply: Available through Life Insurance Corporation (LIC) offices and online. Submit application form, age proof, identity proof, address proof, bank account details. Purchase offline or online through LIC website.

description: Small savings scheme for girl child's education and marriage. Part of Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign.
eligibility: Account opened by parent/guardian for girl child below 10 years. One account per girl child, maximum 2 per family.
benefits: Current interest rate 8.2% per annum (revised quarterly). Tax exempt under Section 80C (up to ₹1.5 lakh). Maturity after 21 years from opening or marriage after 18. Partial withdrawal allowed (50%) after 18 years for education.
how_to_apply: Open at post office or authorized banks with girl child's birth certificate, parent's identity/address proof, ₹250 initial deposit. Minimum ₹250/year, maximum ₹1.5 lakh/year. Deposit can be made till 15 years from opening.

description: Long-term tax-saving investment scheme backed by Government of India offering attractive interest rate.
eligibility: Any Indian resident individual. Hindu Undivided Family (HUF) not eligible. NRIs cannot open new accounts.
benefits: Current interest 7.1% per annum (revised quarterly). Completely tax-free under EEE status. Lock-in period 15 years (extendable). Minimum ₹500/year, maximum ₹1.5 lakh/year. Partial withdrawal from 7th year. Loan facility from 3rd to 6th year.
how_to_apply: Open at designated post offices or banks (SBI, ICICI, HDFC, etc.). Submit application form, identity proof, address proof, photograph, initial deposit ₹500. Can be opened online through net banking. One account per person.

description: Government-backed savings scheme for senior citizens offering regular income and high interest.
eligibility: Indian resident aged 60 years or above. Retired civilians aged 55-60. Defense personnel aged 50+ can open.
benefits: Current interest 8.2% per annum (revised quarterly). Quarterly interest payout. Maximum deposit ₹30 lakh (₹15 lakh per account, can open joint account). 5-year maturity (extendable by 3 years). Tax deduction under Section 80C. Premature closure allowed after 1 year with penalty.
how_to_apply: Open at post office or authorized banks with age proof, identity proof, address proof, retirement proof (if applicable). Initial deposit required. Interest credited quarterly to savings account. TDS applicable if interest exceeds ₹50,000/year.

description: Fixed-income investment scheme for small to medium investors with tax-saving benefits.
eligibility: Any Indian resident individual including minor. HUF and trusts can also invest.
benefits: Current interest 7.7% per annum (compounded annually but payable at maturity). 5-year lock-in period. Minimum investment ₹1,000, no maximum limit. Tax deduction under Section 80C. Accrued interest also eligible for deduction (except final year). Can be used as collateral for loans.
how_to_apply: Available at post offices across India. Submit application form, identity proof, address proof, photograph, initial investment amount. Nomination facility available. Interest compounds annually but paid at maturity.

description: Scheme to provide affordable housing to urban and rural poor with credit-linked subsidy.
eligibility: Economically Weaker Section (EWS), Low Income Group (LIG), Middle Income Group (MIG). Annual income criteria apply. Should not own pucca house.
benefits: Interest subsidy on home loans: 6.5% for EWS/LIG, 4-3% for MIG. Subsidy on loan up to ₹6-12 lakh depending on category. Carpet area: 30-60 sqm for EWS, 60-160 sqm for others. Women ownership or co-ownership encouraged.
how_to_apply: Apply through participating banks, housing finance companies, or Common Service Centers (CSC). Submit income proof, identity proof, address proof, property documents, loan sanction letter. Subsidy directly credited to loan account, reducing EMI.

description: Income support scheme providing ₹6,000 per year to farmer families in three equal installments.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families. Institutional landholders and those in higher income category excluded.
benefits: ₹2,000 directly transferred to bank account every 4 months (April, August, December). No restriction on land size. Benefits all farmers regardless of holding size.
how_to_apply: Register on PM-KISAN portal or through Common Service Centers. Aadhaar mandatory. Submit land records, bank account details, Aadhaar, mobile number. State governments verify records. eKYC required.

description: Facilitates bank loans for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs for greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, or trading sector.
eligibility: SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs aged 18+ with new greenfield project in manufacturing/services/trading. At least one loan per category per bank branch.
benefits: Composite loan ₹10 lakh-₹1 crore. Margin money requirement: 25% (15% by borrower, 10% from promoter schemes). 18-month moratorium on principal. Repayment up to 7 years. Convergence with other government schemes. Handholding support through stand-up connect centers.
how_to_apply: Apply through bank branch or online portal. Submit project report, identity proof, caste certificate (for SC/ST), proof of business registration, property documents for collateral. Training support available.

scheme_name: Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGSMSE)
description: Guarantees collateral-free loans to micro and small enterprises to promote entrepreneurship.
eligibility: New and existing micro and small enterprises in manufacturing and service sector. No previous loan defaults.
benefits: Collateral-free loans up to ₹2 crore (₹1 crore for services sector). Cover up to 85% of sanctioned amount. Reduces loan approval time. Lower interest rates. Enable credit flow to small businesses.
how_to_apply: Apply through lending institutions (banks, NBFCs). Submit business plan, registration certificate, identity proof, ITR, bank statements, GST registration. Guarantee fee charged by bank (one-time annual fee).

description: Accidental death and disability insurance scheme providing ₹2 lakh coverage for accidental death or disability.
eligibility: Indian residents aged 18-70 with savings bank account. Auto-debit consent required.
benefits: Premium: ₹12 per year. Coverage: ₹2 lakh for accidental death or total permanent disability, ₹1 lakh for partial permanent disability. Renewable yearly. Simple enrollment process.
how_to_apply: Enroll during enrollment period (June 1 annual) through your bank by filling consent form. Auto-debit on or before June 1. Existing members auto-renewed. Premium deducted from savings account. Claim through bank with required documents.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: Life insurance scheme providing ₹2 lakh life coverage to individuals aged 18-50.
eligibility: Indian residents aged 18-50 with savings bank account. Auto-debit consent required.
benefits: Premium: ₹436 per year (inclusive of GST). Coverage: ₹2 lakh on death due to any reason. Renewable yearly till age 55. No medical examination required.
how_to_apply: Enroll through your bank by submitting consent form and nominee details. Auto-debit annually on or before June 1. Enrollment period May 1-June 1 each year. Claim by nominee through bank with death certificate and claim form.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
description: World's largest health insurance scheme providing ₹5 lakh health cover per family per year.
eligibility: Eligible families based on Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 data. Covers bottom 40% population (approximately 50 crore beneficiaries).
benefits: ₹5 lakh cashless health cover per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization. Covers 1,393 procedures. Portable across India. No age limit or family size restriction. Pre-existing diseases covered. Over 23,000 empaneled hospitals.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility on Ayushman Bharat website using mobile number or HHID. Visit nearest empaneled hospital with Aadhaar or ration card. Hospital verifies eligibility and provides cashless treatment. No enrollment or premium required - automatic coverage if eligible.

description: Mechanism to transfer subsidies and benefits directly to bank accounts of beneficiaries electronically.
eligibility: Beneficiaries of various government schemes. Requires Aadhaar-linked bank account.
benefits: Eliminates intermediaries and reduces corruption. Faster disbursement. Transparency in transfer. Covers LPG subsidy, scholarship, pension, MGNREGA wages, PM-KISAN, and 300+ schemes. Real-time tracking.
how_to_apply: Ensure Aadhaar is linked to bank account. Seed Aadhaar with respective scheme (LPG provider for gas subsidy, school for scholarship). Benefits automatically transferred to account. Track on DBT Bharat portal using Aadhaar or mobile number.

description: Provides adequate and timely credit to farmers for agriculture and allied activities at subsidized interest rates.
eligibility: Individual/joint borrower farmers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, self-help groups of farmers. Landholding proof required.
benefits: Interest rate: 7% (2% interest subvention + 3% prompt repayment incentive = effective 2%). Flexible withdrawal. Validity 5 years. No processing fee. Coverage for crop insurance, personal accident insurance (up to ₹50,000). Revolving credit facility.
how_to_apply: Apply through banks (commercial, cooperative, regional rural banks). Submit land records, identity proof, address proof, passport photo. RuPay KCC issued. Credit limit based on scale of finance for crops. Renewal every 5 years.

description: Provides information on nutrient status of soil and recommended fertilizers to improve soil productivity.
eligibility: All farmers holding agricultural land. Priority to beneficiaries of PMKISAN.
benefits: Free soil testing. Detailed soil health card with nutrient status (macro and micro nutrients). Crop-wise fertilizer recommendations. Improves soil productivity. Reduces fertilizer cost. Issued every 2 years.
how_to_apply: Contact local agricultural department or Krishi Vigyan Kendra. Soil samples collected from fields (2.5 hectare grid). Tested at soil testing labs. Soil health card issued in 30 days with digital copy. Available through mKisan portal and KCC centers.

description: Crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against crop loss due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
eligibility: All farmers (loanee and non-loanee) growing notified crops in notified areas.
benefits: Premium: 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, 5% for horticultural crops. Balance premium paid by government. Coverage from sowing to post-harvest. Covers prevented sowing, mid-season adversity, localized calamities. Use of technology (smartphones, drones, satellites) for assessment. Claims settled within 2 months.
how_to_apply: Loanee farmers automatically enrolled by banks. Non-loanee farmers apply through CSC, agriculture department, insurance company portal, or CropIn app. Enroll within 7 days of sowing. Submit land records, Aadhaar, bank details, declaration. Notify within 72 hours of crop loss.

description: Cloud-based platform for storing and accessing digital documents issued by government departments.
eligibility: Indian citizens with Aadhaar card and mobile number.
benefits: Secure digital document storage (1 GB free). Access government-issued documents (driving license, PAN, vehicle RC). Legally valid e-documents. Share documents electronically. Eliminates physical document requirements. Integration with various government services.
how_to_apply: Download DigiLocker app or visit website. Register using Aadhaar number and OTP verification. Create 6-digit security PIN. Upload documents or pull from issuing authorities. Access anytime via mobile or web. Link with UMANG for additional services.

scheme_name: UMANG (Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance)
description: Single mobile app providing access to multiple government services across Central and State governments.
eligibility: All citizens. Available in 13 Indian languages and English.
benefits: Access 1,200+ services: PAN, Aadhaar, Passport, EPFO, ESIC, Digilocker, Bharat Bill Pay, railway/bus booking, scholarships, utilities. Single sign-on using Aadhaar/mobile. Works on all platforms (Android, iOS, Windows, web, SMS, IVRS). Secure platform.
how_to_apply: Download UMANG app from Play Store/App Store or visit website. Register using mobile number. Verify OTP. Select language. Access required service. Link Aadhaar for additional features. Can be used without registration for basic services.

description: Digital payment solution for targeted welfare delivery - cashless and contactless voucher-based system.
eligibility: Beneficiaries of government schemes and corporate CSR programs.
benefits: Purpose-specific prepaid voucher delivered via SMS or QR code. No need for bank account, digital payment app, or internet. One-time payment without leakage. Ensures benefits reach intended beneficiaries. Used for vaccine distribution, drug schemes, fertilizer subsidy.
how_to_apply: Issued by sponsoring entity (government/corporate) through partner banks. Beneficiary receives SMS with unique voucher code or QR code. Redeem at empaneled service provider by sharing code/QR. Amount settled between bank and service provider.

description: Allows bank customers to use Aadhaar number for financial transactions through micro ATMs using biometric authentication.
eligibility: Aadhaar holders with bank account linked to Aadhaar. Available at banking correspondents and micro ATMs.
benefits: Cash withdrawal, cash deposit, balance inquiry, mini statement without ATM card. Biometric authentication. No transaction fee for basic services. Interoperable across all banks. Rural banking penetration. Used for DBT disbursement.
how_to_apply: Link Aadhaar with bank account. Visit banking correspondent or micro ATM. Provide Aadhaar number, select bank, select transaction type. Authenticate using fingerprint or iris scan. Complete transaction. Receipt provided.

description: Interoperable platform for bill payments offering instant confirmation and multiple payment modes.
eligibility: All utility bill payers. Over 20,000 billers onboarded including electricity, gas, water, telecom, DTH, insurance, loan EMI, municipal taxes.
benefits: One-stop payment for all bills. Instant confirmation receipt. Multiple payment modes (cash, cards, net banking, UPI, wallets). Transaction status tracking. Complaint redressal mechanism. Available 24×7. Accessible through agents, banks, and apps.
how_to_apply: Pay through authorized agents, bank branches, internet banking, mobile banking, or payment apps (Paytm, PhonePe, Google Pay). Select biller and bill category. Enter customer ID/consumer number. View bill amount. Choose payment mode. Receive instant confirmation.

description: Voluntary defined contribution pension scheme for building retirement corpus regulated by PFRDA.
eligibility: All Indian citizens aged 18-70. Mandatory for Central Government employees joining after 2004.
benefits: Choice of pension fund managers and asset allocation. Low cost (fund management fees 0.01%). Tax benefits: ₹1.5 lakh under 80C + additional ₹50,000 under 80CCD(1B). Partial withdrawals allowed. At retirement: 60% lump sum withdrawal (tax-free), 40% annuity purchase (for pension).
how_to_apply: Open through eNPS online portal or Point of Presence (PoP) - bank branches, post offices. Submit application, Aadhaar, PAN, bank details, photograph. Choose pension fund and asset allocation. Minimum ₹500 for opening, ₹1,000 annually. Receive Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN).

description: Provides retirement benefits through EPF (savings), EPS (pension), and EDLI (insurance) for organized sector employees.
eligibility: Salaried employees in establishments with 20+ employees. Voluntary for smaller establishments.
benefits: EPF: 12% employee + 12% employer contribution (8.33% to EPS, 3.67% to EPF). Current interest 8.25%. Tax-free if withdrawn after 5 years. EPS: Monthly pension after 58 years. EDLI: Life insurance up to ₹7 lakh. Online account management through Unified Member Portal.
how_to_apply: Employer registers establishment and enrolls employees. Universal Account Number (UAN) allotted. Link Aadhaar, PAN, bank account with UAN. Access services through UMANG app or EPFO portal. Claims (withdrawal, transfer, pension) processed online. No need to visit office.

description: Health insurance and cash benefits for organized sector workers and families with income up to ₹21,000/month.
eligibility: Employees earning up to ₹21,000/month in notified factories and establishments. Includes temporary, permanent, seasonal employees.
benefits: Free medical care for self and family at ESI hospitals/dispensaries. Sickness benefit (70% wage), maternity benefit (100% wage for 26 weeks), disablement benefit, dependent benefit, funeral expenses. Contribution: 0.75% employee, 3.25% employer.
how_to_apply: Employer registers at ESIC and generates Insurance Number (IP Number) for employees. Link Aadhaar for family. Get PEHCHAN card (family card). Access medical facilities at ESI centers. Claim cash benefits through employer or online portal.

description: Health insurance for Below Poverty Line (BPL) families providing hospitalization coverage. (Note: Being replaced by AB-PMJAY)
eligibility: BPL families as per SECC data. Some states extended to additional categories.
benefits: ₹30,000 hospitalization cover per family per year. Cashless treatment at empaneled hospitals. Covers pre-existing diseases. Transportation allowance. Smart card for identification. Minimal enrollment fee (₹30).
how_to_apply: Enrollment through camps organized by state nodal agency. Submit BPL card, Aadhaar, family details. Biometric enrollment. Smart card issued on spot. Show card at empaneled hospital for cashless treatment. Most states transitioned to AB-PMJAY.

description: National initiative to promote gender equality, prevent sex-selective abortion, and ensure girls' education.
eligibility: Targets all districts with low child sex ratio. Focus on girl child 0-18 years.
benefits: Awareness campaigns on gender equality. Strict implementation of PC-PNDT Act. Improved girl child education enrollment. Linking with Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana. Multi-sectoral approach involving health, education, women and child development.
how_to_apply: Implemented through district administration. Community participation and awareness programs. Multi-media campaigns. Monitor child sex ratio and girl child education. No direct financial benefit to individuals but links to SSY for savings.

description: Umbrella scheme to train youth in industry-relevant skills through Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) and other programs.
eligibility: Youth aged 15-45 (varies by scheme). School/college dropouts, unemployed, under-employed.
benefits: Free short-term training (150-300 hours) in 40+ sectors. Assessment and certification by Sector Skill Councils. Post-training placement support. Stipend for residential training. Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) for existing skills. International certification for some courses.
how_to_apply: Register on Skill India Portal. Choose training center and course near you. Enroll with Aadhaar, education certificates. Attend training (average 3 months). Take assessment test. Receive certificate from National Skill Development Corporation. Access job fair/placement support.
